messages:
Alex Kim: FYI incoming pen test next Monday 09:00 UTC. Primary asks: RBAC changes for assessors, audit log export proof, KMS key access for evidence ingest. Need owners for each lane.
Maria Gonzales: I can own the RBAC and evidence staging. Plan is to create an assessor role with least privilege and a read-only service account for log pulls. Will lock down to specific resource ARNs.
Jin Park: +1. We'll scope to service accounts and tag with `pt:assessment=true`. Quick IAM sketch: 
```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence-2026/*"]},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/pt-assess-key"}
  ]
}
```
Jin Park: We'll not give sts:AssumeRole to humans; only the assessor SA can assume.
Samir Patel: For KMS, we need an alias `alias/pt-assess-2026`. Add grant for the assessor SA only and deny on export_to_external if possible. Also set key rotation policy to manual for the assessment window.
Maria Gonzales: Audit logging: retention for object-level logs needs to be 90d for evidence, and we need syslog/CloudTrail exports to the read-only bucket. I'll prepare a runbook with the exact console steps + CLI commands.
Alex Kim: Can we get the CLI commands inline so assessors can verify? Example presigned upload/download flow would help reviewers.
Jin Park: Presigned GET example: `aws s3 presign s3://pt-evidence-2026/assessor.zip --expires-in 3600` — we'll centralize in the runbook. Also adding `--request-payer` if we ever move cross-account.
Maria Gonzales: Timeline ask: RBAC & KMS grants done by Thu EOD, evidence bucket and retention by Fri morning, dry-run of evidence snapshot Fri 16:00 UTC. Can ops run the dry-run? @Samir
Samir Patel: I can run the dry-run and verify KMS grants and CloudTrail exports. I'll also validate that the assessor SA only has Get/List and DescribeKey.
Alex Kim: Remediation tracking: create a short JIRA board PT-RET (epic) with tickets per vuln. We need a retest window 48–72 hours after fixes. Maria/Jin own evidence proof tasks, Samir owns KMS/ops verification.
Maria Gonzales: Also adding ephemeral creds note — we'll issue STS tokens for the assessor SA with TTL 1h during the assessment window to reduce blast radius.
Samir Patel: OpsBot reminder: I'll open a scheduled maintenance window and prep rollback steps (revoke grants, rotate alias) if anything goes sideways.
OpsBot: (automated) Created ticket PT-642: pen-test dry-run & evidence check. Reminder set for 2026-05-07T16:00:00Z.
Alex Kim: Last ask — anyone got outstanding compliance questions (PCI/GDPR) for data in the evidence bucket? We should add a masking step if PII shows up.
Maria Gonzales: Good point. I'll add a pre-flight filter and an S3 Object Lambda transform to redact obvious PII before reviewers download. Will document fallback if transform fails.
Jin Park: I'll update the infra-as-code (Terraform) for the assessor role and KMS alias PR today. Tagging `@alex` for review.
Samir Patel: After dry-run, I'll post logs and a short verification checklist in this channel. Then we can lock the retest slots.
Alex Kim: Perfect — thanks all. Meeting to confirm Thu 10:00 UTC. If anything blocks, flag here. :thumbsup:
